title: The four dimensional helicity scheme beyond one loop
claim: Explains the failure of FDH found in S2.15: FDH sets evanescent couplings equal to the gauge coupling without a renormalization mechanism for them, so the error is O(eps) at NLO, O(eps^0) at NNLO and singular from N3LO. Defines FDH as DR with two extra conditions (4-dimensional external states, alpha_e and eta_1 identified with alpha_s at the end) and gives a procedure (eqs. 10-18) to convert bare FDH amplitudes into properly renormalized HV amplitudes using DR-hat counterterms and SCET-like jet/soft functions.
loop_order: general n-loop conversion; explicit at 1 loop (eq. 20)
scheme: DR with D-dimensional gauge field plus evanescent field (couplings g_e, eta_1..3) renormalized separately; FDH obtained by identification at the end.
symmetry_argument: Not a SUSY argument; notes that in SUSY theories SUSY supplies the missing Ward identity so evanescent components may be treated as gauge bosons (Sec. II.2, IV.5).

proved: Renormalizable definition of FDH as a variant of DR; conversion formula eq. (18).

evidence: Sec. II.2-II.3: why evanescent states are unprotected; error growth with loop order.
Sec. IV.1, IV.3: DR-hat setup and FDH as DR + conditions.
eqs. (8)-(18), App. A eqs. (21)-(25): counterterms, beta functions, jet/soft functions, n-loop relation.
red_flags: For SUSY theories the protection of evanescent couplings is asserted, not demonstrated (outside scope).
